decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program builds directly on the firm's core psychiatric treatment knowledge, so its multidisciplinary teams can interpret utilization data and refine the program, and its dedicated page signals continued commitment.

Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's mental health and outpatient competence and is supported by regulated reimbursement, so the firm can learn from early cases, though its low visibility and the recent pruning of peripheral offers add some risk.

Meal delivery for seniors extends the firm's eldercare and kitchen operations, so it can draw on existing know-how and client access, but it has only one year of evidence and is more logistics than care, which makes it somewhat vulnerable, as the dropped counseling and retail offers were.
